blind2_flags.note: Simplifies Winawer et al. (2007): the reported result was a category advantage. The study did not report Russian speakers being faster than English speakers outright. Verbal interference (rehearsing a digit string) removed the advantage and spatial interference did not, so the item stays accurate. Consider rewording to 'Russian speakers, unlike English speakers, were faster at telling apart blues that fell on opposite sides of that boundary than blues on the same side'.
